findings.detail: The identifier maturity parser converts source maturity 8/31/2028 to 2020-08-31 while the structured maturity remains 2028-08-31.

rationale: Class 2 within-row adjudication. The raw schedule row gives Arrowhead Holdco Company's maturity as 8/31/2028, agreeing with the structured XBRL value 2028-08-31 and contradicting Agent A's parsed 2020-08-31. The defect is therefore in identifier maturity parsing, not in the structured maturity field. Other flagged rows show the same year-truncation pattern, including Race Winning Brands source maturity 5/16/2029 versus Agent A 2020-05-16.
